documentation.content: Sustained 5xx or 429 responses can indicate overload or abuse. See docs/operations/security-observability.md.

conditions.displayName: More than 20 5xx responses per minute for 2 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="gyrinx" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class="5xx"

conditions.displayName: More than 10 429 responses per minute for 2 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="gyrinx" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code="429"
